headline: Two Italians killed in drone strike in Kuwait
pages: Two Italian technicians working for the German arms maker Rheinmetall were killed in a drone strike on a facility in Kuwait on Thursday. Italy's foreign ministry said the pair were doing maintenance on air defense detection systems used by Kuwait's armed forces. Kuwait and Italy both blamed Iran, which denied responsibility and said its military had conducted no offensive operations. Kuwait's defense ministry said four people were hurt by falling shrapnel after drones were intercepted, including a Kuwaiti and a Pakistani national. The attack came just over a week after Kuwait said it repelled Iranian drone attacks on an airbase hosting US forces.

Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni offered condolences, and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen called for more pressure on Iran. The strike adds to fears of wider escalation in the war that began in February. Source: BBC.
